newsitem.title: JAPAN: Iran's Abadan oil refinery running at 350,000 bpd.
newsitem.headline: Iran's Abadan oil refinery running at 350,000 bpd.

text.p: The Abadan oil refinery in southern Iran is running at about 350,000 barrels-per-day (bpd), an official with the National Iranian Oil Products Refining and Distribution Company (NIORDC) said on Tuesday.
Abadan refinery General Manager Nasrollah Mohmmadi told Reuters that the company had no immediate plans to boost refining capacity.
"We have no plans to increase processing capacity, however, we plan to revamp some units," he said.
He said the company planned to upgrade facilities so that the sulphur and salt content of oil products would be lower.
Mohmmadi, in Tokyo to attend an industry symposium, said the moves would also include steps to raise the octane content of gasoline.
The Abadan refinery is the main source for the National Iranian Oil Company's (NIOC) fuel oil exports.
Mohmmadi said most of the products refined at the Abadan Refinery were consumed on the domestic market where demand is growing sharply, especially for middle distillates.
"For the moment we have no plans to increase exports of oil products, but we may consider exports of tar, gas oil and fuel oil in the future," he said.
